title: XDS AD500 2025 mainland specification and frame report
notes: Current exact-2025 report identifies an X6 aluminum frame claimed at 1,250 g, carbon thru-axle fork, L-TWOO ER9 electronic hydraulic 2x12, 50/34T Branta power-meter crank, 11-32T cassette, 160 mm rotors, Branta A30 Ultra wheels and fitted 700x28C tires. Fitted 28C is not a manufacturer maximum, and the source publishes no controlled stiffness protocol.
